notes:
I found three real drop-in options in Calgary, each on the operator's own page. None of the pages posts a price.


- **YMCA Calgary:** The page gives a weekday schedule and says families must stay in the room with their children.
- **Families Matter:** The page I read gives no day or time for this Genesis afternoon group. It lists other Families Matter drop-ins too, including Connect + Play at Horizon and Midnapore.
- **RISE Calgary:** The page doesn't state an age range for the play groups, so I haven't claimed that it fits a toddler. The page also lists a Tuesday Mother Goose program.

I left out the Genesis Centre Active Toddlers free drop-in because I only found it on a listings site, not the venue's own page. I left out Mount Pleasant Playgroup because the schedule I found was for Fall 2025.
